ChangeProposals

Approve and apply pending operations of a change proposal, as its requester or a reviewer

Approves the chosen pending operations (each chosen key also approves the other pending operations on the same page), or every pending operation when operationKeys is omitted, and applies them before responding. "in-progress" means another run holds the apply; it applies the approved operations, and its optional results hold the caller's operations as freshly read so a client can show progress. The requester and the reviewers may approve, each only the operations on pages they may view; anyone else, and a reviewer who may view none of its pages, gets the same 404 as a missing id. Requires the write:features:page scope.

Authorizations:
(beareraccessTokenHeaderAuthaccessTokenInQuery)
path Parameters
id
required
string
Request Body schema: application/json
operationKeys
Array of strings [ 1 .. 1000 ] items

Responses

https://demo.growi.org/_api/v3/change-proposals/{id}/approve

Get a change proposal as the caller may see it

Returns only the operations on pages the caller may view; a viewer other than the requester gets no proposed bodies, no requester state and no pending operations. A missing, malformed or entirely invisible proposal gets one identical 404. The requester and the reviewers also get reviewer-facing values: reviewers and, per operation, order, baseIsLatest, approval (with byRequester, true when the requester approved it), rejections and abstentions; the requester alone gets wholeRejections. Requires the read:features:page scope.

Comments

List the comments of a page

Returns the regular comments and the inline comments of a page, including replies, newest first (by creation time). Use isInline to tell them apart. When revisionId is given, only the comments created before the next revision of the page (the oldest revision created after the given one) are returned, whichever revision they were posted on. If the given revision is the latest one, all comments are returned. If the given revision does not exist or belongs to another page, the response is 404 notfound_or_forbidden. Access is allowed to a user who can view the page, or to anyone holding a valid shareLinkId for the page (in which case revisionId is ignored). Authentication with an access token requires the scope read:features:page.

Authorizations:
(beareraccessTokenHeaderAuthaccessTokenInQuery)
query Parameters
pageId
required
string

ID of the page.

revisionId
string

ID of a revision of the page. Return only the comments created before the page's next revision after this one. Responds with 404 if the revision does not exist or belongs to another page.

shareLinkId
string

ID of a share link for the page. Used only to authorize access for users who cannot view the page directly.

Responses

Create an inline comment

Creates an origin inline comment anchored to a passage of the page body. See InlineCommentAnchor for how the anchor is measured and how it is used when the page is displayed. Requires login, or an access token with the scope write:features:page, and permission to view the page. Not available through a share link. Read-only users are refused unless read-only users are allowed to comment.

Authorizations:
(beareraccessTokenHeaderAuthaccessTokenInQuery)
Request Body schema: application/json
required
pageId
required
string

ID of the page.

anchorOriginRevisionId
required
string

ID of the page revision the anchor was taken from: the latest revision when the passage was chosen.

comment
required
string

Comment body (markdown).

required
object (InlineCommentAnchor)

Where an inline comment points in the page body. Every value is measured against the page body as rendered in the browser, as plain text (the text a reader sees and selects, without markdown syntax), not against the markdown source. When the page is displayed, the passage is searched for again with quote and approxOffset: an exact match first, then the closest approximate match; if neither is found the comment is still shown, only without a highlight.

Deletes a reply to an inline comment. Only the creator may delete. Requires login, or an access token with the scope write:features:page, and permission to view the page. Not available through a share link. Read-only users are refused unless read-only users are allowed to comment.

(beareraccessTokenHeaderAuthaccessTokenInQuery)

Deletes an origin inline comment together with all of its replies. Only the creator may delete. To delete a single reply, use DELETE /inline-comments/replies/{id}. Requires login, or an access token with the scope write:features:page, and permission to view the page. Not available through a share link. Read-only users are refused unless read-only users are allowed to comment.

Resolve or unresolve an inline comment thread

Marks an origin inline comment as resolved or unresolved. Only origin comments have a resolved state. Anyone who may comment on the page may do this, not only the creator. Requires login, or an access token with the scope write:features:page, and permission to view the page. Not available through a share link. Read-only users are refused unless read-only users are allowed to comment.

Authorizations:
(beareraccessTokenHeaderAuthaccessTokenInQuery)
path Parameters
id
required
string

ID of the origin inline comment.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
resolved
required
boolean

true to resolve the thread, false to reopen it.

Responses

Revisions

Get the authenticated user's consecutive-edit runs across all pages

Returns a paginated list of "runs" — maximal sequences of the authenticated user's consecutive edits on individual pages, not interrupted by another author. Each entry includes the baseline revision (from) and the final revision (to) of the run, along with page accessibility flags. The response is ordered by (latestUpdatedAt asc, toRevisionId asc) for stable incremental sync. Authentication requires a Personal Access Token with scope read:features:page.

Authorizations:
(beareraccessTokenHeaderAuthaccessTokenInQuery)
query Parameters
since
string <date-time>

Inclusive lower bound on revision createdAt (ISO 8601).

fromDate
string <date-time>

Start of the date range (inclusive). Combined with since: the effective lower bound is the later of the two values.

toDate
string <date-time>

End of the date range (inclusive). Must not be earlier than fromDate; violating this constraint returns 400.

limit
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
Default: 20

Maximum number of run entries to return.

cursor
string

Opaque pagination cursor returned in the next field of a prior response. An invalid cursor token returns 400.

Responses

/{server}/_api/v3/revisions/changes
https://demo.growi.org/_api/v3/revisions/changes

Response samples

  • 200
Content type
application/json
{
  • "changes": [
    • {
      • "pageId": "string",
      • "path": "string",
      • "fromRevisionId": "string",
      • "toRevisionId": "string",
      • "authorId": "string",
      • "latestUpdatedAt": "2019-08-24T14:15:22Z",
      • "accessible": true,
      • "deleted": true
      }
    ],
  • "next": "string"
}

Compute unified diffs for a batch of revision pairs

Accepts a list of revision pairs (up to MAX_PAIRS) and returns a per-pair unified diff result. Authorization is performed independently per pair: pairs the authenticated user cannot view return status "forbidden"; structurally invalid pairs (revision not found, wrong page) return status "invalid". Authentication requires a Personal Access Token with scope read:features:page.

Authorizations:
(beareraccessTokenHeaderAuthaccessTokenInQuery)
Request Body schema: application/json
required
required
Array of objects <= 20 items
contextLines
integer [ 0 .. 20 ]
Default: 3

Number of context lines in the unified diff output

Responses

https://demo.growi.org/_api/v3/revisions/diff

/users/usernames

Get list of usernames. q matches by case-insensitive prefix (it matched anywhere before v8). activitySnapshotUser still matches by substring, so mixedUsernames can merge results found by different rules.

Authorizations:
(beareraccessTokenHeaderAuthaccessTokenInQuery)
query Parameters
q
string
Example: q=alice

query string to search usernames

offset
integer [ 0 .. 1000 ]
Example: offset=0

Offset for pagination. Capped: it becomes a skip(), whose cost grows with the value.

limit
integer
Example: limit=10

limit for pagination

options
string
Example: options={"isIncludeActiveUser": true, "isIncludeInactiveUser": true, "isIncludeActivitySnapshotUser": true, "isIncludeMixedUsernames": true, "isIncludeTotalCount": true}

Options for including different types of users. isIncludeTotalCount adds totalCount to every returned group; it is omitted by default because counting matches is an order of magnitude more expensive than returning the page.

Responses

/{server}/_api/v3/users/usernames
https://demo.growi.org/_api/v3/users/usernames

/ai-settings

Update the AI settings. Each top-level section (aiEnabled / providers / allowedModels) is omit = leave unchanged; a present section is a full-state replace. In env-only mode (env:useOnlyEnvVars:ai) a request that contains providers or aiEnabled is rejected with 400 (connection settings are env-only); only allowedModels stays editable.

Authorizations:
beareraccessTokenInQueryaccessTokenHeaderAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
aiEnabled
boolean

Toggle for app:aiEnabled. Omit = unchanged.

object

Per-provider update sections keyed by provider (openai, anthropic, google, azure-openai). Omit = unchanged; when present, all four entries are required.

Array of objects

The cross-provider allow-list (full-state replace). Omit = unchanged; an empty array is stored as "no allowed models". When non-empty, every entry needs a supported provider, a non-empty unique (provider, modelId) pair, and exactly one entry must be the default.

Responses

/{server}/_api/v3/ai-settings
https://demo.growi.org/_api/v3/ai-settings

Update the change proposal settings

Admin only. Requires the write:admin:app scope. Omitted fields stay unchanged; unknown fields are refused. Turning isEnabled off withdraws every pending change proposal before the response. Refused with 400 while the settings are fixed by environment variables (useOnlyEnvVars).

required

boolean
enabledOperationTypes

autoApplyPolicy
string
Enum: "none" "own-pages" "all"
maxOperationsPerProposal
integer or null >= 1

maxProposalsPerUserPerDay
integer or null >= 1

perPageNotificationsEnabled
boolean

/search/indices

Operate indices

Authorizations:
(beareraccessTokenHeaderAuthaccessTokenInQuery)
Request Body schema: application/json
required
operation
string
Enum: "normalize" "rebuild"

Operation type against to indices > * normalize - Normalize indices * rebuild - Rebuild indices

includeAttachments
boolean

With rebuild, also rebuild the attachment full-text index after the pages. The response does not wait for completion; progress and the result are sent over Socket.io (finishAddAttachment / attachmentRebuildingFailed).

Responses

/{server}/_api/v3/search/indices
https://demo.growi.org/_api/v3/search/indices

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "operation": "normalize",
  • "includeAttachments": true
}

Response samples

  • 200
Content type
application/json
{
  • "message": "string"
}

AiUsage

/ai-usage

Get the GROWI-wide AI usage totals since each given start time, and the freshness of the model catalog used for weighting. Only the exact path accepts requests; any other spelling returns 404.

query Parameters
since
required
Array of strings <date-time> [ 1 .. 10 ] items [ items <date-time > ]

Start times (1 to 10) as ISO 8601 date-times with a timezone, not in the future and not more than 90 days ago. Repeat the parameter for multiple values; encode '+' as %2B.

Responses

/{server}/_api/v3/ai-usage
https://demo.growi.org/_api/v3/ai-usage

Content type

  • "growiAppIdForCloud": 0,
